rules.promotion: Required predecessor stages must be VALIDATED unless an explicit dependency says otherwise.
rules.architecture_change_behavior: BLOCK_AND_REOPEN_OWNING_DESIGN; do not silently alter frozen UX contracts.

stages.title: Implementation program, authority, and contract freeze
stages.objective: Create the child implementation authority, program artifact, machine-readable stage plan, and requirement traceability matrix pinned to the UX-13 freeze.
deliverables: child v2 task capsule + derived handoff
stages.exit: Child implementation task is handoff-safe enough to begin repository/bootstrap work and no code path is authorized outside its explicit scope.

stages.title: Repository skeleton, build, CI, and frozen-contract harness
stages.objective: Create the operator-bridge solution/tree, dedicated validation workflow, protocol implementation copy/check, build/test skeleton, and invariant tests before behavior implementation.
deliverables: frozen protocol copy or generated artifact with drift check
stages.exit: Empty/minimal implementation compiles and CI can deterministically enforce frozen contracts.

stages.title: Windows helper kernel
stages.objective: Implement tray/master toggle, RegisterHotKey adapter, write-only clipboard adapter, single-flight dispatch coordinator, redacted diagnostics, and fake application/browser ports.
validation: clipboard last-safe-moment tests with fake BrowserPort
stages.exit: Helper kernel satisfies UX-05 local behavior using fake ports; no browser dependency is required.

stages.title: Native Messaging proxy and same-user local IPC
stages.objective: Implement protocol v1 framing, helper native-host proxy mode, CurrentUserOnly named pipe, version negotiation, request correlation, idempotency, and reconnect behavior.
validation: proxy disconnect leaves primary helper alive
no packet body/raw URL allowed by protocol tests
stages.exit: Browser adapter can communicate with helper through bounded typed IPC without authority leakage.

stages.title: Firefox Manifest V3 browser adapter
stages.objective: Implement the Firefox baseline adapter using only nativeMessaging/tabs/sessions, with managed binding lifecycle, origin reduction, and no content/page automation.
validation: no raw URL crosses IPC test
binding metadata contains no packet/credential content
stages.exit: Firefox BrowserPort implementation exists and remains inside UX-08 least-privilege boundary.

stages.title: Deterministic simulator and local fake worker
stages.objective: Implement UX-10 scenario controller, fake worker, fake durable events/ack observer, virtual clock, fault injector, and production/simulator build separation.
validation: simulator-only endpoint absent from production protocol/package
stages.exit: Full deterministic fake-worker environment exists without a ChatGPT account.

stages.title: Real helper + Firefox + fake-worker integration
stages.objective: Run the real Windows helper, Native Messaging, Firefox adapter, and local fake worker through the UX-10 L2/L3 scenarios.
validation: all UX-10 CORE/AUTHORITY/ACK/INPUT/IDENTITY required L2/L3 tests PASS
stages.exit: Routine bridge mechanics work end-to-end against fake workers with real OS/browser adapters.

stages.title: Crash, auth-domain, stale-generation, restart, and recovery closure
stages.objective: Complete UX-07/UX-10 recovery scenarios with real helper/browser adapters and deterministic faults.
validation: all UX-10 recovery/crash/generation fixtures at required implemented layers PASS
late old-generation evidence cannot advance current
restart never replays stale local cache
Ctrl+B during blocking recovery cannot stage worker packet
stages.exit: Single-component and auth-domain failures have bounded tested recovery with no authority duplication.

stages.title: Per-user packaging, signed-extension flow, install/uninstall, and rollback
stages.objective: Make the baseline installable/recoverable without admin authority or credential/profile scraping.
validation: uninstall removes only owned files/registry entries
stages.exit: A reviewed per-user baseline can be installed, updated, and rolled back safely.

stages.title: Execute UX-09 performance/resource benchmark
stages.objective: Measure helper/extension and Firefox fake-worker mechanics on target Windows hardware using the frozen UX-09 procedure.
validation: no fake-worker result misrepresented as real ChatGPT RAM
stages.exit: Mechanical performance is measured; any failing budget is corrected or explicitly escalated before usability/promotion.

stages.title: Execute UX-11 human-in-loop simulator trials
stages.objective: Run the physical operator trials against fake workers, including 5/20-action batches, recovery, interruptions, and hotkey collision.
deliverables: UT-01 through UT-12 result records as required
stages.exit: Human-in-loop simulator UX passes or the affected physical binding/presentation is revised and rerun.

stages.title: Conditional WebView2 custom-shell comparison
stages.objective: Implement the smallest BrowserPort-equivalent WebView2 fake-worker spike and decide whether it merits auth testing/promotion.
validation: fake-worker adapter parity PASS before auth test
if real-auth feasibility is attempted, no cookie/token import or bypass
stages.exit: WebView2 is REJECTED/DEFERRED or remains a promotion candidate; Firefox baseline is unaffected.

stages.title: Bounded real-account security/policy/authentication calibration
stages.objective: Perform the smallest real ChatGPT calibration only after all explicit pre-real-account gates pass.
stages.exit: Real-account baseline is explicitly PASS/BLOCKED/REVISE with no policy/security workaround.

stages.title: Integrated implementation review and promotion decision
stages.objective: Review code, test evidence, performance, usability, security, packaging, rollback, and real-account calibration before any production promotion.
stages.exit: Explicit PROMOTE_V0, HOLD, or REVISE decision. No implicit production promotion.
